title: Lula Wins Runoff; Flávio Seeks Annulment
dek: Lula takes 51.79% to 48.21%, the first comeback from a first-round loss since 1988.
body: The TSE declared Lula re-elected with 100% counted. Flávio says a two-hour voting extension broke the rules.

panels.label: Lula's Camp Says
panels.text: Lula says the result was a “defeat of lies” and that Brazil will not be “anyone's backyard.”

panels.label: Bolsonaro's Camp Says
panels.text: Flávio Bolsonaro says the result is “impossible” to recognize and that he will seek its annulment.

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: One camp says the vote was won, the other that the rules were changed; at stake is who the courts let decide an election.
